front.title: Source-Directed Propagation of VPN Prefix ORF for BGP-4

abstract.t:
The Virtual Private Network (VPN) Prefix Outbound Route Filter (ORF) [I-D.ietf-idr-vpn-prefix-orf] mechanism allows a Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) speaker to request that an adjacent peer filter matching VPN routes. In deployments using Route Reflectors (RRs) or Autonomous System Border Routers (ASBRs), the adjacent peer may not be the source of the affected routes.
This document specifies when an intermediate router may send an ordinary VPN Prefix ORF to the upstream peer from which the affected routes were received. Upstream transmission is permitted only after the intermediate router determines that no relevant downstream router requires the affected routes. This document also defines an Interest Query/Response procedure for making that determination.
